rules_of_construction: Every chapter in every pack under packs/<slug>/chapters/ is assigned to exactly one capability cluster (best fit).
Cross-cutting chapters carry a remark noting the strong secondary fit.

glossary.md / patterns.md / cheatsheet.md may appear as support-file rows; this bullet is descriptive only and defers to support_policy. is_support assignment rows are the membership source of truth (do not derive omission of multi-cluster pack support files from this rule).
The two signpost packs (omg-signpost, se-standards-signpost) contain no chapters and are not mapped.
A standard's own process definitions go to cluster 30 (Standards, Tailoring & Process Models); performing the capability goes to the capability cluster.
support_policy: Support-file membership is encoded per assignment in `assignments` (`is_support` true rows); this field is descriptive and not a derivation rule. Packs with one dominant cluster and only noted cross-cutting chapters elsewhere carry support rows; legacy exceptions: mil-std-881f, nasa-std-8719-14, dod-mq-bok.
